title: Understanding the Normal Equations
text: The normal equations for linear regression are derived from setting the gradient of the loss function to zero. This results in a system of equations that can be solved for the coefficients.

title: Checking for Unique Solutions
text: A unique solution to the normal equations exists if the design matrix X has full column rank. This means that the columns of X are linearly independent.

title: Role of the Intercept Term
text: Including an intercept term in the model ensures that the mean of the residuals is zero, which is a key assumption in linear regression.

hintAnswer: X must have full column rank meaning its columns are linearly independent.
